description.value: South Swell Cabins is a collection of eight individually named oceanfront cabins nestled along Spring Cove on the rugged West Coast of Vancouver Island in Ucluelet. The property sits steps from the Wild Pacific Trail and a direct kayak/paddleboard launch, with the cedar barrel sauna and foreshore trail adding to its coastal character. A touring cyclist would find it an atmospheric and well-located base, within walking distance of Ucluelet's restaurants, breweries, and groceries.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website is fully accessible and provides rich content about South Swell Cabins. The site mentions 'biking' as one of the available activities and describes the property as walkable to 'restaurants, coffee shops, breweries, groceries and entertainment,' confirming nearby food and grocery. Wi-Fi is explicitly listed as a standard cabin amenity ('high-speed wifi'). No bike storage, tool, laundry, drying, or e-bike charging facilities are mentioned anywhere on the site, so those remain null. The OSM name 'Southswell Cabins' (one word) differs from the website's consistent branding 'South Swell Cabins' (two words), which is flagged as a concern.
